examples.en: My grandfather collects old records.
I like the warm sound of records.
Dust has piled up on the record.
I saw a record spinning for the first time.

examples.ko: 그 가수의 레코드는 이제 구하기 어려워요.
examples.en: That singer's records are hard to find now.
I played music for my friend on a record.

explain: '레코드판'이라고도 하고 'LP'라고 부르기도 해요. 인터넷으로 듣는 음악은 '음원'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: An old song is coming out of the record.
phrases.nuance_ko: '레코드'보다 동그란 판 자체를 또렷하게 가리키는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A clearer way to refer to the round disc itself.

phrases.en: My father played a record for me.
phrases.nuance_en: Pairs with 틀다 to mean playing music.

phrases.en: I listen to music on LPs.
phrases.nuance_ko: 큰 레코드판을 부르는 또 다른 말이에요. 말할 때는 '엘피'라고 읽어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Another name for the large record. When speaking, it is read aloud as 엘피 (el-pi).

explain_en: It is also called 'rekodeupan' or 'LP'. Music you listen to online is called 'eumwon'.

examples.en: I sketch trees in the park.
Yesterday I sketched the sea.
It rained while I was sketching.
A pencil is handy when you sketch.
I want to sketch my friend's face.
After sketching, I will add color.

explain: '그림을 그리다'보다 가볍게 대강 그린다는 느낌이에요. 보통 '풍경을 스케치하다'처럼 그리는 대상을 목적어로 써요.

phrases.example: 그림을 그리기 전에 먼저 연필로 스케치해 보세요.
phrases.en: Before drawing, try sketching with a pencil first.
phrases.nuance_en: A suggestion form used when recommending that someone try sketching.

phrases.en: I sketch in the park every weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: '스케치하다'와 뜻이 같고, 명사 '스케치'에 '를 하다'를 붙인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as the headword, built from the noun 'sketch' plus 'do'.

phrases.en: I went on a trip and sketched the sea view.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그리는 대상이 풍경일 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing, when the thing being sketched is a landscape.

explain_en: It feels lighter than 'geurimeul geurida': a quick, rough drawing. The thing you draw is usually the object, as in 'punggyeongeul seukechihada'.

examples.en: The new movie's trailer came out today.
The trailer is only two minutes long.
I watched the trailer together with a friend.
My favorite actor appears in the trailer.
Even the trailer is fun, so I look forward to the movie.
The music in the trailer was really cool.

explain: 드라마의 다음 회 안내는 '다음 회 예고'라고 하는 경우가 많아요. 영화에는 '예고편'을 써요. 둘 다 짧은 영상이에요.

phrases.en: I bought a ticket after watching the movie trailer.
phrases.nuance_ko: '영화'를 앞에 붙여 무엇의 예고편인지 분명히 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding 영화 makes clear what the trailer is for.

phrases.en: I'm watching a trailer before bed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 예고편을 볼 때 가장 흔하게 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common collocation for watching a trailer.

phrases.example: 드라마가 끝나고 다음 회 예고가 나왔어요.
phrases.en: After the drama ended, the next-episode preview came on.
phrases.nuance_ko: 드라마의 다음 이야기를 알려 주는 짧은 영상에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the short preview of a drama's next episode.

explain_en: For a drama's next episode people often say '다음 회 예고', while '예고편' is used for movies. Both are short videos.

examples.en: The theme song of this movie is so good.
When I hear the theme song, I think of that drama.
Who sang the Olympic theme song?
I memorized the theme song lyrics and sang along.
My friend changed the ringtone to a cartoon's theme song.

examples.ko: 드라마 주제곡의 첫 소절만 들어도 알아요.
examples.en: I can tell from just the first line of the drama's theme song.

explain: '주제가'는 가사가 있는 노래를 가리키고, '주제곡'은 가사 없는 연주곡까지 넓게 가리킬 수 있어요. 영화, 드라마, 만화, 게임처럼 작품마다 대표 음악이 있을 때 써요.

phrases.en: I listen to this movie's theme song every day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞에 작품 종류를 붙이면 어떤 작품의 주제곡인지 분명해져요.
phrases.nuance_en: Putting the type of work in front makes clear which work the song belongs to.

phrases.en: My friend sang the drama's theme song.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가사가 있는 주제곡을 노래할 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when someone sings a theme song that has lyrics.

phrases.en: The theme song came on at the end, and I cried.
phrases.nuance_ko: 영화나 드라마에서 음악이 흘러나올 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the music plays in a movie or drama.

explain_en: 주제가 points to a song with lyrics, while 주제곡 can also cover instrumental pieces without lyrics. You use it when a work such as a movie, drama, cartoon or game has a signature piece of music.

examples.en: The kids are playing in the dirt at the park.
My clothes got all dirty from playing in the dirt.
When I was little, I played in the dirt every day.

examples.ko: 우리 아들은 흙장난이 세상에서 제일 재미있대요.
examples.en: My son says playing in the dirt is the most fun thing in the world.

examples.ko: 비 온 뒤에는 흙장난하기 딱 좋아요.
examples.en: After the rain, it's perfect for playing in the dirt.

examples.ko: 흙장난은 그만하고 손 씻고 밥 먹어요.
examples.en: Stop playing in the dirt, wash your hands and eat.

explain: '흙장난하다'라고도 하고, 주로 어린아이의 놀이를 말해요. 비슷한 '모래놀이'는 모래로, 흙장난은 흙으로 노는 것이에요.

phrases.en: The child is playing with dirt in the yard.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form, written as one word instead of '흙장난을 하다'.

phrases.en: My younger sibling likes playing with dirt.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe a child's likes.
phrases.en_equiv: to like playing in the dirt

phrases.en: The children are playing in the sand.
phrases.nuance_ko: 흙 대신 모래로 하는 비슷한 놀이예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A similar play, but with sand instead of dirt.

explain_en: You can also say '흙장난하다', and it mostly refers to young children's play. The similar '모래놀이' is playing with sand, while 흙장난 is playing with soil.
